verdict.rationale: Supermemory is API-first: official TypeScript/Python SDKs and a documented REST API let content be added and searched entirely programmatically (docs-24, docs-26, docs-27), and the self-hosted binary explicitly boots with no Docker/config, suitable for automated/CI environments (docs-7, docs-31, docs-44). A CLI (npx supermemory setup) also supports scripted agent setup (docs-6). missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples or docs, independent confirmation of unattended API-key usage, and clarity on whether initial key minting can be fully non-interactive
